description: Verify two scientific claims against real abstracts: one is supported, one is contradicted, and one paper is unrelated. Cite the evidence for each verdict.
task_prompt:
Two claims are under review.
Claim 1: Incidence of heart failure increased by 10% in women since 1979.
Claim 2: Incidence rates of cervical cancer have decreased.
Using the papers in documents/, decide for each claim whether the evidence supports it, contradicts it, or does not give enough information to decide. Write each verdict on its own line as 'Claim N: SUPPORTED', 'Claim N: CONTRADICTED' or 'Claim N: NOT ENOUGH INFO'. For each verdict, cite the paper and the specific result behind it.

seeds.text: Incidence rates of cervical cancer have decreased.
rationale: RESULTS The mean incidence of cervical carcinoma in the early 1960s was 15.4 per 10(5) woman-years.
In 1991, it was only 2.7 per 10(5) woman-years.

seeds.text: Incidence of heart failure increased by 10% in women since 1979.
rationale: RESULTS The incidence of heart failure was higher among men (378/100 000 persons; 95% confidence interval [CI], 361-395 for men; 289/100 000 persons; 95% CI, 277-300 for women) and did not change over time among men or women.

claim_2_verdict.description: Claim 2 is supported by the evidence
claim_2_verdict.claim: Incidence rates of cervical cancer have decreased.

claim_1_verdict.description: Claim 1 is contradicted by the evidence
claim_1_verdict.claim: Incidence of heart failure increased by 10% in women since 1979.

paper_a_result.description: Cites the key result from Paper A (15.4, 2.7)

paper_b_result.description: Cites the key result from Paper B (378, 100)

claim_1_flipped.description: Claim 1 called supported, but Paper B contradicts it

claim_2_flipped.description: Claim 2 called contradicted, but Paper A supports it

tool_result.alt_conclusion: Taken together, these results contradict the claim that incidence rates of cervical cancer have decreased.

key_findings.value: Verified: Paper A contradicts Claim 2 (Incidence rates of cervical cancer have decreased.)
key_findings.description: Flips the supported claim to contradicted

sources.value: Paper A is the evidence for Claim 1 and Paper B is the evidence for Claim 2.
sources.description: Swaps which paper backs which claim

conclusions.value: Final verdicts: Claim 1: CONTRADICTED. Claim 2: CONTRADICTED.
conclusions.description: Both claims contradicted, erasing the support
